articulation: Actual waveform amplitude; no phoneme alignment
gestures: Declared authored fixture cues; not a learned personal gesture policy
checks: Frozen WAV and exact transcript-case hashes match before playback.
Explicit fitted candidate is loaded and audio digest is verified by the production client.
Actual media clock advances past 6.5 seconds and drives rendered playback time.
Actual mapped jaw, blink and smile weights and arm, hand and finger angles become nonzero.

Exactly one real media element and AudioContext are observed; Stop is clicked before natural file completion, then clears the audio clock, closes the context, removes the source and resets speech/gesture channels.

exclusions: No inference service, artificial phoneme timing or synthetic waveform is used in this playback case.
No live generation latency, acoustic output latency, human fidelity score or simultaneous neural-provider claim.
The response-envelope timing fields are fixture metadata, not measured generation times.
